name: Settlement Parties 119
definition: Chain of parties involved in the settlement of a transaction, including receipts and deliveries, book transfers, treasury deals, or other activities, resulting in the movement of a security or amount of money from one account to another.

Party2.name: Party 2
Party2.definition: Party that, in a settlement chain interacts with the party 1.

Party3.name: Party 3
Party3.definition: Party that, in a settlement chain interacts with the party 2.

Party4.name: Party 4
Party4.definition: Party that, in a settlement chain interacts with the party 3.

Party5.name: Party 5
Party5.definition: Party that, in a settlement chain interacts with the party 4.

Party3PresenceRule.definition: If Party3 is present, then Party2 must be present.

Party4PresenceRule.definition: If Party4 is present, then Party3 must be present.

Party5PresenceRule.definition: If Party5 is present, then Party4 must be present.

BookTransferGuideline.definition: In case of own account internal transfer, own account external transfer, portfolio transfer and in specie transfer (see SecuritiesTransactionType), the account of (delivering) Party2 at (delivering) Party1 must be provided.|For more details, see the relevant market practice document on www.smpg.info.
